name: capture_screen
summary: Capture the screen to an image file and return its path, dimensions, and size. Saves into a server-owned scratch directory (the caller does not choose the destination); open the returned path to view the image. Requires the Screen Recording permission (System Settings → Privacy & Security → Screen Recording); a denied permission is reported with a grant hint. Captures the whole desktop, never a specific window or region (those are not yet supported).

params.name: display
params.description: 1-based index of the display to capture (1 is the main display). Omit to capture the main display.
